title: SKE Crystal 2400 4in1 Lychee Ice Pre-Filled Vape Pods 20mg - 4 x Pods
description: Embark on a tropical taste adventure with exotic Lychee Ice flavour in these SKE Crystal 4in1 prefilled pods. Each pod combines the sweet, delicately floral taste of luscious lychee with a cool, refreshing burst of crisp ice, delivering an exhilarating and exotic MTL vaping experience. The Nic-Salt vape juice ensures a smooth and flavourful draw with every puff. The SKE Crystal 4in1 Vape Pods replicate the popular flavours of SKE Crystal Disposable Vapes in a more cost-effective and eco-friendly format. Designed for the SKE Crystal 4in1 Prefilled Pod Kits, these easy-to-use pods fit seamlessly into the device's rotating mechanism, allowing you to enjoy four flavours in one handy vape kit.
